title: Nickel Processing Optimization
thesis: Snowflake optimizes nickel processing — Dynamic Tables maintain real-time plant KPIs, ML.FORECAST projects recovery rates, ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flags process drift, and Cortex AI generates shift-level operator guidance

talking_points: Eight processing lines across Morowali and Weda Bay — average nickel recovery at 89.2%.
Energy intensity at 45 MWh/tonne Ni product — 12% above industry best practice.
Line 3 HPAL autoclave showing declining recovery trend — 86.1% last week.
tabs.call_out: 89.2% average recovery — Line 3 declining to 86.1%, needs attention

transition.line: Let's drill into what's causing the recovery drop in Line 3.

talking_points: One million sensor readings across temperature, pressure, flow, and pH per day.
Line 3 autoclave temperature 8°C below optimal — acid consumption 15% above target.
Recovery correlates strongly with feed grade and autoclave temperature (R² = 0.87).
show: Show autoclave temperature profile for Line 3
tabs.call_out: Line 3: temperature 8°C low, acid 15% high — root cause identified

transition.line: The process data points to temperature. Let's see what ML predicts.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects Line 3 recovery dropping to 84% if temperature drift continues.
Process drift detection flagged 2 lines operating outside optimal envelope this shift.
AI-generated recommendation: increase steam input to Line 3 autoclave by 5%.
show: Show recovery forecast with confidence bands
tabs.call_out: ML projects 84% recovery without intervention — AI recommends 5% steam increase

transition.line: Now let the VP ask about overall plant efficiency.

talking_points: Dedi asks: 'What's the average nickel recovery across all HPAL lines?'
Cortex Analyst queries plant data — returns 89.2% overall, with Line 3 at 86.1%.
Follow-up: 'What process changes would improve Line 3 recovery?' — agent searches SOPs and generates guidance.
show: Switch to advisory mode for optimization
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: plant analytics + process optimization advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, native ML.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
IoT Core replaced by Snowpipe Streaming; SageMaker by ML.FORECAST.
Indonesia's nickel processing capacity is 1.5Mtpa. This optimizes 8 lines producing battery-grade NPI/MHP.
tabs.call_out: One platform, real-time process data, native ML for recovery optimization

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for process optimization.
